metadataRaw.title: How to SAFELY Pop Your Full Back
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates how to safely pop your entire back for INSTANT PAIN RELIEF!

This video provides an easy, step-by-step guide featuring exercises to self-mobilize, release, or pop your back—from the base of the neck to the tailbone.

The focus is on improving mobility throughout the back, which can help reduce pain, tightness, and improve your spine's range of motion.

Bonus: These back-stretching exercises can be done anywhere—at home, work, or virtually any place, anytime! Relieve pain and tightness quickly, and achieve the pop or release you're after.

Watch now to learn how to safely pop your back at home for fast relief!

Link to foam roller: https://amzn.to/40pjQcp
